## What changed

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link relevant issues.

## Testing

List the commands and manual checks you ran, with their results.
For UI or integration changes, include the Mac, macOS version, permissions, and commands tested.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Documentation matches changes to behavior, setup, or outbound data.
- [ ] Test data and diagnostics contain no credentials or private user data.
- [ ] Routing changes include labelled cases and pass the evaluation gate.
- [ ] Performance claims include their workload, measurement boundary, and evidence.
